audio.text: What time does the library close?

why.en: "What time" → a time. A gives a place; B repeats "close" with a different meaning; D answers "Yes" to a "what time" question.
why.tr: "What time" → bir saat. A bir yer veriyor; B "close" kelimesini farklı anlamda tekrarlıyor; D "what time" sorusuna "Yes" diyor.
why.es: "What time" → una hora. A da un lugar; B repite "close" con otro significado; D responde "Yes" a una pregunta con "what time".
